name: DemoShaft
_comment: Turned shaft: Ø16 x 90 revolve boss along x, O-ring groove at mid-length via revolve_cut on the opposite side (grooved_shaft README 'A note on opposite-side cuts'). End chamfers via literal-point edge selectors (the revolve body has no of_feature/+x-style faces for a semantic selector). Groove profile corrected from the task brief's starter (center.y=-8 would sit half outside the Ø16 body): grooved_shaft's rule is center.y = -(R - depth/2) = -(8 - 0.5) = -7.5 for a 1mm-deep groove. Driving dims (SHAFT_DIA/SHAFT_LEN + friends) sourced from locals.txt; center/centerline/edge-point fields stay literal -- schema rejects {rhs} there (confirmed empirically on demo_baseplate), so those numbers must be kept in sync by hand if locals.txt changes.

features.name: SK_Groove
features._comment: Opposite side (-y) from SK_Body's +y profile, per grooved_shaft's chained-revolve handedness rule. 1mm-wide radial band from the R=8 surface inward to R=7: y spans [-8,-7], center.y=-7.5.

features.name: CHA_Ends
features._comment: Literal-point selectors on the two end circular edges (x=0 and x=90, both at radius 8 i.e. y=8,z=0) -- revolve_boss features carry no extrude_axis metadata, so of_face/between_faces (which require a built-extrusion parent) aren't available here; see dress_up.py _select_edges parent.extrude_axis guard.
